intro.heading: Play classic KoGaMa again
intro.text: OpenKogama brings back the KoGaMa you remember. More than 600 versions of the game, from the first 2012 build to 2026, work again. Play old KoGaMa maps, build your own worlds and meet your friends, right in the browser or with the launcher for Windows.

official.question: Is OpenKogama the official KoGaMa?
official.answer: No. OpenKogama is a fan-made community project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Multiverse ApS, the company behind KoGaMa.

versions.question: Can I play old versions of KoGaMa?
versions.answer: Yes. The launcher for Windows has more than 600 KoGaMa versions, from 2012 to 2026, and over 500 of them also run in the browser with no install.

maps.question: Can I still play old KoGaMa maps?
maps.answer: More than 28,000 KoGaMa maps were archived. Find one on the {maps} page by name, author or id and play it in the browser.

free.question: Is OpenKogama free?
free.answer: Yes. OpenKogama is free and open source. If you want to support it, you can donate on {kofi}.

server.question: Can I host my own KoGaMa server?
server.answer: Yes. The {server} is open source and supports plugins, so you can run your own server and play with friends.
